description: This Java source file defines the class 'MonkeyPowerEvent', which is part of the 'com.android.commands.monkey' package. It implements a specialized event for power measurement within the Android 'monkey' testing framework. The class includes methods for buffering and logging power-related events, handling log file writing, and managing event injection related to power testing.

classes.name: MonkeyPowerEvent
classes.description: Represents a special event for power measurement in Android's monkey testing framework, capable of buffering and writing power-related log events.
